purpose: Teach: 素晴らしく/長々/目の当たり/ひいては/がらみ/つれづれ/なにせ/もろもろ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は素晴らしく繊細なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your drawings are wonderfully delicate.
lines.style: Warm and genuine admiration. Soft, unhurried delivery. The ease of someone offering honest praise to someone she cares for. Slight lean-in with the compliment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、長々とお絵描きの説明しちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I kind of went on and on explaining my art.
lines.style: Sheepish but genuine. Small, knowing smile in the voice. Self-aware without self-pity. The quietness of someone who realizes he's been talking but doesn't regret it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の頑張りを目の当たりにしたわね
lines.en: Sho, you really got to see your friend putting in the effort.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not commentary. Warm tone. Noticing what matters without making a big thing of it. The quiet certainty of someone who sees something good happening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ひいてはメイ姉さんみたいになりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I want to be like you someday.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. No hesitation, but soft around the edges. The vulnerable kind of earnest only a child can manage. Looking up, meaning every word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達がらみの相談ならメイ姉さんに聞いてね
lines.en: Sho, if you ever want to talk about your friends, come ask me.
lines.style: Open-door generosity. Warm but straightforward. Not performing care — just offering it. Like an invitation she's extended before and will again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、つれづれにお花のスケッチしたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I want to sketch some flowers just for the sake of it.
lines.style: Gentle enthusiasm. Unhurried. The quiet excitement of doing something creative without pressure. Small, genuine eagerness in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、なにせ初めての場所だから不安よね
lines.en: Sho, it's your first time here, so it makes sense you'd feel anxious.
lines.style: Reassuring without dismissal. Matter-of-fact kindness. Acknowledging the worry while normalizing it. The tone of someone who understands without needing explanation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、もろもろの画材を持ってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I brought all my art supplies.
lines.style: Quiet pride mixed with readiness. No boasting — just fact stated with gentle confidence. The happiness of being prepared for something you care about.
